checks.name: pending independent source read holds numeric placements and both consumers
one measured result supplies two SVG consumers at corrected original pixel row
identity revocation synchronously removes previous verified placement
same image/report reconfirmation waits for a fresh bound result
new confirmation object invalidates otherwise unchanged report binding
replaced report ignores late completed response even when transport ignores abort
image A to B to A cannot resurrect prior image-A measurement
explicit held OCR response keeps all source placement withheld
reader rejection remains held and never reuses prior verified coordinates
shared view removal does not trigger another OCR read or clear valid parent evidence
unmount aborts pending OCR and suppresses its later completion
no browser exceptions, external network requests, or provider calls

limitations: Synthetic local raster and controlled OCR boundary; no real OCR/scanner accuracy or latency acceptance
